circumstances: The researcher runs the one controlled evaluation-subset comparison planned on Day 19. The alternative subset brings one reported metric closer to the reference result, but the overall pattern still does not reproduce exactly. A final code/configuration audit finds no remaining obvious implementation mismatch, while the paper leaves enough evaluation detail unspecified that further reconstruction would require assumptions. The researcher documents the partial reproduction and pauses the replication rather than continuing to chase an exact match. The day also includes a small amount of literature reading about reproducibility and evaluation reporting, plus a long offline period.

activities.title: Run the controlled evaluation-subset comparison

key_observations: The controlled evaluation-subset comparison changed the replication result in the expected direction for one metric but did not produce an exact reproduction of the reference result.
The remaining discrepancy is not explained by an obvious preprocessing or implementation mismatch.
The researcher followed the predefined stopping rule and paused the replication instead of adding undocumented reconstruction variants.
The replication now provides a partial reproduction with an explicit unresolved evaluation-procedure ambiguity.
Possible next research directions were collected but deliberately not selected on the same day as closing the replication.
priority_alignment: The main priority was completed: the single controlled follow-up was run and interpreted.
The replication was closed at the intended boundary rather than expanding into a broad benchmark.
Post-submission exploration began only after the replication decision was documented.
important_uncertainty: The exact evaluation procedure used for the reference result remains partly unrecoverable from the available materials.
It is unclear whether a more exact reconstruction would materially change the scientific conclusion.
No next research question has yet been chosen, so the list of ideas should not automatically become a new project queue.
